subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Tenderness
solution:
The correct answer is **"Kindness".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Tenderness -** It is a quality of being gentle, loving and kind.
 
• **Synonyms -** Affection, fondness etc.
 
• **Example -*** She treats her child with tenderness.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Ruthlessness - **The quality of not thinking or worrying about any pain caused to others when deciding what you need to do.

 
 
• **Example -** *He behaved with utter ruthlessness.*
 
 
 
• **Severity **- Unkind or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example -** *He doesn't realize the severity of the problem.*
 
 
 
• **Spitefulness -** The quality to annoy, upset or hurt another person, because you are angry with them.
 
 
• **Example -*** She has a spiteful child.*
